amended_1.label: PRIMARY never_green = no kept SIP trade in (T, T + hold] reaches entry_price x 1.0005, hold = exit_time - T (floor 300 s, capped 1800 s); the 300 s fixed-horizon label and the desk's peak_price label are cross-checks only. Forward tape is fetched to max(T+300, exit_time).
amended_1.fill_time: known limitation: outcomes carry no fill time, so prints between submission and fill count toward the window and the label reference is the fill price; arm-to-fill delays of 70 s+ were documented. No fill-time field exists, so this is stated, not fixed.
amended_1.ties: weak flow = (ofi60, u) <= the 1/3 point of half A under that lexicographic order, u = seeded sha256 uniform per entry; the weak share must be 25-42% in ALL, A and B or the verdict is ABORT_SHARE.
amended_1.drops: dropped entries (no file, < 5 signed trades, no post-entry tape) are counted by half; if total drops exceed 10% the verdict is UNPROVEN_DROPS.
amended_1.confounds: never-green gap (weak - rest) must be positive in >= 2 of 3 terciles of BOTH spread_bp at T (last clean SIP quote) and the 60 s pre-entry trade range, as well as pooled and in each half; a pooled gap of at least 5 points is also required.
amended_1.payoff: payoff and never-green are one test of the same grouping; payoff is reported at 3 bp (the scoreboard convention, a round-trip allowance; fills already include the touch spread) and at 0 bp.
amended_1.power: each half needs >= 12 days and >= 80 weak entries, else UNDERPOWERED.
amended_1.strata: all three terciles of BOTH spread_bp and the 60 s range must be evaluated (>= 15 weak and >= 15 rest each) and >= 2 of 3 positive, else UNDERPOWERED; entries missing a spread or range are counted in strata_missing
